youtube.title: Why Wind Turbines Have Exactly Three Blades 🌬️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Large modern wind turbines almost always have three blades, even though two blades would be cheaper and a single blade with a counterweight can also work. A two-bladed rotor shakes the tower as it turns to face the wind, because its weight is uneven in different positions. A fourth blade adds only a little power for much more weight and cost. Three blades spread the load evenly and are the cheapest count that spins smoothly.
